profile.list.searchPlaceholder: Search profiles, name, Kuaishou ID or ID card number
account.savedToast: Account record saved; this does not mean you are logged in to the platform.
account.unboundToast: Unbound. The record is kept and cookies are not cleared; the profile-only purpose is retained.
account.staleToast: The action completed, but the latest status could not be read. Reload and do not submit again: {{detail}}
account.disclaimer: Account information is unverified. Only the type, alias and platform user ID are recorded manually; this does not mean you are logged in or exempt from login, and cookies are not shared. Each profile can be linked to only one record at a time; records are never overwritten, moved or merged automatically.
account.saveNote: This section saves separately. Switching sections keeps the draft; closing the edit page discards unsaved record changes.
account.stoppedRequired: The profile must be stopped before binding, changing or unbinding. The running state is only a hint; the backend validates it finally.
account.existing.profile: Includes records kept after the environment was deleted; records already linked to another profile do not appear here.
account.field.profile: After saving, this profile will be marked as Magnet Jinniu exclusive…
account.field.id: Platform ID (optional; manual entry does not mean logged in)
identity.statusTitle.text: The browser is closed or closing; the running state is determined finally by the backend
identity.scanOpened: The Kuaishou Shop login page is open; scan the QR code in the browser. This does not mean you are logged in.
identity.scanFailed: Failed to open the Kuaishou Shop login page. Open the profile and try again.
identity.openShop.text: Launch this environment and open the Kuaishou Shop QR page; the start page and login data are unchanged. Unavailable for Jinniu environments.
identity.refreshNote: Reads the Rust backend result · does not mean logged in or initialized
identity.conflict.id: Record conflict: the manual platform ID differs from the detected result;…
identity.conflict.text: Record conflict: the backend reports an identity record conflict;…
identity.copyFailed: Copy failed; select and copy the Kuaishou ID manually
identity.lastInfoSuffix: · the following is the last detection info
identity.rows.rust: Rust backend · Kuaishou Shop page identity detection (local result)
errors.identityInvalid.text: Identity detection result has an invalid format
errors.identityInvalid.profile: Identity detection result does not match the requested profile
subject.noteDetectVsInit: Identity recognition is not the same as completed initialization; completed collection is not the same as manually verified.
subject.readFailed: Failed to read the initialization status. Refresh in the details view.
subject.photo.text: Failed to load the photo. Refresh the record.
subject.toast.text: Failed to load the record. Refresh and try again.
subject.toast.ocr: Local Chinese OCR is unavailable. Check the system language resources; nothing is downloaded or uploaded automatically.
subject.save.text: Correction saved and re-validated. Compare with the photo and confirm.
subject.form.text: No photo is available; cannot confirm.
subject.noArchive: No subject record yet; a recognized identity does not mean the data has been collected.
subject.archives.id: Search by name, Kuaishou ID or ID card number; records are kept even after the environment is deleted. Environment filters do not affect record results.
